build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.gpl: flight-authority::navball shared 128px instrument renderer; old pilot keeps thin Bevy image wrappers, native HUD uploads to a shared-device egui texture
ownership.mit: existing render-core frames/instances and render-wgpu terrain/mesh/device/queue unchanged; renderer has no UI toolkit dependency
ownership.asset: North American X-15 Plane by cmoreau, CC BY 4.0; assets/models/north_american_x-15_plane.LICENSE.txt
ownership.readback_boundary: existing optional final captures and hardware test assertions read back; no runtime per-frame scene readback

navball_contract.renderer: verbatim moved pixels: nose-+X sphere view, sky/ground blend, 11-contour pitch ladder, horizon glow, edge shade/alpha; bit-deterministic per input; degenerate local-up falls back to +Z
navball_contract.rebuild_policy: shipped 30Hz/travel-hysteresis (4e-6 squared) adopted in the native HUD, gated on presentation time for deterministic headless captures
navball_contract.host_split: old client converts pixels to a Bevy sRGB image with its texture lifecycle; native loads ColorImage into the existing egui renderer (LINEAR) beside the terrain overlay
navball_contract.scope: attitude sphere only; markers/ladder overlays/telemetry cards stay old-client-only
navball_contract.excluded: model judging, capture automation and performance budgets (proposed in doc 55, not implemented)

stationary_offscreen.boundary: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/upload/GPU-completion latency; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and capture readback
stationary_offscreen.conclusion: overlapping medians; no speedup claimed, no adapter tax isolated

live_offscreen.telemetry: throttle=1.000 engine=true control_mode=Navball sas=true rcs=true wheels=true gear=true chutes=false spd=372.2 vspeed=+49.3 alt=942 agl=848
live_offscreen.boundary: full existing local physics demand + per-frame sampling/navball-upload + presentation/streaming/terrain/mesh/HUD/uploads/GPU completion; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and final readback; not isolated instrument cost or game FPS
live_offscreen.comparison_boundary: different camera cover between orbit/chase; not equal-scene runs and not Bevy parity; trajectory (not pixels) is the identity

verification.new_regressions: shared dynamic deterministic sphere projection with degenerate fallback; old-client rendering through the shared function; native HUD branch rendering without touching controls
verification.review: pixel-renderer move exactness, rebuild-policy parity, shared-device texture path, GPL/MIT separation

native_wayland_smoke.boundary: host presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback, GPU-only time or game FPS

legacy_bevy_smoke.environment: THESSA_AUTOBENCH=1 THESSA_AUTOBENCH_VIEW=pilot THESSA_SCREENSHOT_PATH=IMAGE.png THESSA_SCREENSHOT_AT_S=6; not paused
legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: embedded server executable absent: existing local fallback; shared navball pixels with Bevy wrappers; different camera/time/game controls/effects, not audio/network validation or equal-scene parity

captures.meaning: normal terrain-only new-1 HUD regression frame
actual local authority at 10.5s with the owned navball beside speed/altitude readout
legacy unpaused local-fallback pilot on shared navball pixels; not equal-scene parity

limitations: Attitude sphere only: markers, ladder overlays, telemetry cards, alerts and autopilot blocks stay old-client-only.
Survey/map camera still legacy; materials remain base-color/Lambert without PBR/shadows/atmosphere parity.
Captures are not visual acceptance or equal-scene Bevy parity; blind-arena judging is out of scope for this slice.
No device-loss recovery, persistent conforming GPU bisector topology or FastRT acceleration structures are established by this slice.
